parameters.content:
## 50 Reminders and Expiry

Runs daily at 08:00.

### 1. Chases people who have gone quiet
Only on **draft** events whose *Send reminders* field is Yes, and only rows whose status is in `CHASEABLE_STATUSES`. After `REMINDER_FIRST_DAYS` and `REMINDER_SECOND_DAYS` the person gets a reminder with their **personal link** (a token is created and saved if the row has none). After `EXPIRY_DAYS` the coordinator is told and the row is marked `expired`. Nobody is removed from an event automatically.

Age is measured from the row's last reminder, response or update. Administrate does not tell n8n when you send an invitation, so somebody who never asks for their personal link has no row and is not chased.

### 2. Refreshes the staffing summary
For every draft event with invitation rows, whether or not reminders are on, by calling 20. If an event has become fully staffed since the last run (for example a coordinator was added after the last acceptance), 20 sends the staffing complete email and publish link, exactly as it does for 40, and only once.

### Paging
**Fetch Draft Events** reads events 100 at a time and follows `pageInfo` to the end, up to 50 pages (5,000 events). Each page is one item, and **Who Needs Chasing** and **Events To Refresh** read every page.

### Setup
Administrate OAuth2 credential on **Fetch Draft Events**, **Send Reminder or Notice**, **Log Success** and **Log Failure**. Fill in Config, then activate.

Run it by hand with no event opted in first: it should send nothing and still refresh summaries.

## Config

**RESPONSE_BASE_URL** - production URL of **30 Response Form**.

**SUMMARY_WORKFLOW_ID** - ID of **20 Recompute Event Summary**.

**REMINDERS_FIELD_KEY** - `definitionKey` of the Event Yes/No field that opts an event in.

**CHASEABLE_STATUSES** - invitation statuses still worth a nudge.

**REMINDER_FIRST_DAYS** / **REMINDER_SECOND_DAYS** / **EXPIRY_DAYS** - cadence in days.

**FALLBACK_LOG_EVENT_ID** - an event to attach a failure log to when no event is known yet. Use a draft event kept for the purpose.

**SENDING_ADDRESS_ID**, **INVITATIONS_TABLE_ID**, **COORDINATOR_ROLE_NAME**, **FALLBACK_ROLE_NAME**, **VERB_BASE**, **VERB_GERUND**, **CHECKBOX_TRUE_VALUES**, **BRAND_NAME** and the email styling keys - as in 40.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query ChaseContext($ids: [String]!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { events(filters: [{ field: id, operation: in, values: $ids }], first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } edges { node { id title lifecycleState customFieldValues { definitionKey value } requiredStaff { quantity staffRole { id name } } staff { edges { node { id staffRole { id name } contact { id firstName lastName } } } } } } } }', variables: { ids: $json.eventIds, first: 100, after: null } }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch Draft Events
nodes.notes: Reads every event that has an invitation row, 100 per page, following pageInfo until there are no more (up to 50 pages, so 5,000 events). Each page is one output item; the nodes after it read all of them.

nodes.name: Recompute Summary
nodes.notes: Calls 20 Recompute Event Summary (SUMMARY_WORKFLOW_ID in Config) so the summary is refreshed after a chase. If that completes staffing, 20 sends the staffing complete email.

nodes.name: Which Events To Check
nodes.notes: Collects the distinct events that have an unresolved invitation, so only those are read back from Administrate.

nodes.name: Events To Refresh
nodes.notes: One item per draft event this automation holds rows for. Published and cancelled events are skipped, because their staffing is settled and the field will not change again.

nodes.name: Refresh Summary
nodes.notes: Calls 20 once per draft event. 20 only writes when the text changed, and when the event has just become fully staffed it sends the staffing complete email and publish link itself, so nothing more is needed here.
